mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO quant_live_user_stream_lease (credential_id, owner_token, lease_epoch, lease_until) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, 1, DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND))
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_user_stream_lease SET lease_epoch=IF(owner_token<>#{owner} OR lease_until<=NOW(6), lease_epoch+1, lease_epoch), owner_token=#{owner}, lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND (owner_token=#{owner} OR lease_until<=NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT lease_epoch FROM quant_live_user_stream_lease WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>NOW(6)

SELECT CONCAT( 'schema=', DATABASE(), ', owner=', owner_token, ', epoch=', lease_epoch, ', lease_until=', DATE_FORMAT(lease_until, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), ', db_now=', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(6), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), ', remaining_ms=', TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, NOW(6), lease_until) DIV 1000 ) FROM quant_live_user_stream_lease WHERE credential_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_live_user_stream_lease WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>NOW(6)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_live_user_stream_lease WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_epoch=#{epoch} AND lease_until>NOW(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_user_stream_lease SET lease_until=NOW(6) WHERE credential_id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>NOW(6)
